recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Future requests for additional GoalCategory codes should use the THO/UTG process, as FHIR-46145 and UP-599 did, rather than altering the Goal.category element for this historical seed.
issue_request: FHIR-7884 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care request to add Goal.category to Goal as a 0..* CodeableConcept with definition 'Indicates a category that the goal falls within', requirements 'Allows goals to be filtered and sorted', and example category values such as treatment, dietary, safety, behavioral, nursing, and physiotherapy.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify SVN #6806. In migrated git history, 8bd3bd917d added Goal.category to the Goal spreadsheet with the requested cardinality, type, definition, requirements, example GoalCategory binding, category search parameter, and GoalCategory value set; 33b409a4b6 later carried that content into the current StructureDefinition/search-parameter source layout.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by Patient Care. Current source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml has Goal.category 0..* CodeableConcept with the requested definition, requirements, and example binding, and source/goal/bundle-Goal-search-params.xml has a Goal-category token SearchParameter. Later Goal.category context preserves this approach: FHIR-10622 kept the example FHIR-defined value set, Zulip clarified that treatment-like codes are allowed under the example binding, and FHIR-46145/UP-599 routed later code additions through THO/UTG.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current built core source already contains the semantic change requested by FHIR-7884; changing core source to duplicate prose or to manage the THO code system would not improve the application of this seed issue.
